messages:
nina_cs: Quick debrief from Kelp onboarding (15m). They surfaced 4 asks + one operational blocker. Renewal review in ~6 weeks so marking for triage.

raj_cs: Items captured: 1) embedding index updates not reflected in search for ~12h after reindex. 2) Finance wants per-route cost CSV export. 3) Route-level service quotas (limit per team). 4) Admin UX: CSV bulk-invite errors on >200 rows (blocking for their SSO rollout).

opsbot: Ticket created: CS-5033 (bulk-invite CSV error) https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-5033 tags: kelp, impact:medium

claire_prod: Can CS paste the exact repro query and reindex time? Also did they trigger an incremental or full reindex? Need to know to reproduce.

nina_cs: Reindex time they reported: 2026-01-22T09:18:11Z. Repro snippet they ran: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/search -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"route":"kelp-kb","query":"billing breakdown by team"}'``` They toggled client caching off, still saw old rows.

ben_pm: Sounds like a KV/invalidation fanout gap. If true, temporary ops invalidate could buy time. @claire_prod any quick triage notes or ETA?

claire_prod: Hypothesis: reindex event not clearing route prefix in runtime cache. Ask CS to share control-plane event log and runtime logs near 09:18Z. If confirmed, estimate: 2 engineers, ~3 business days for a safe fix + tests. Ops can run a manual invalidate in the meantime once we verify.

raj_cs: I'll request logs and permission to run invalidate. Customer impact: blocking their feature launch; they've asked for weekly status updates. Suggested priorities from CS: Staleness = P0 (renewal risk), Per-route billing export = P1, Route quotas = P2, Bulk-invite fix = P2.

nina_cs: I'll draft a one-page runbook for the manual invalidate and loop Solutions. Adding AM to renewal watch.
